question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Haughty
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arrogant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Haughty"** means someone who is arrogantly superior and disdainful. It describes a person who behaves as if they are better than others. (अभिमानी, घमंडी)

 
 
• **Example:** The haughty tone of his voice made it clear that he thought little of our opinions.
 
 
 
• **"Arrogant"** refers to having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities. It often conveys a sense of superiority and overconfidence. (अहंकारी)
 
 
• **Example:** The arrogant leader refused to listen to the advice of his team, believing he knew better than everyone else.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **'Haughty'** is **'Arrogant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Arrogant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Modest** (विनम्र): Someone who is humble and does not boast about their achievements.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite her numerous accomplishments, she remained modest and unassuming.
 
 
 
• **Bashful** (शर्मीला): Someone who is shy or easily embarrassed.
 
 
• **Example:** The bashful child hid behind his mother's legs when introduced to the guests.
 
 
 
• **Sheepish** (संकोची): Showing embarrassment from shame or a lack of self-confidence.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave a sheepish smile when his mistake was pointed out.
